content_sections.heading: About GSACS Deputy Director Recruitment
content_sections.text: The Gujarat State AIDS Control Society functions under the Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of Gujarat, implementing the National AIDS Control Programme. Appointments under this notification are made on an 11-month contract basis, structured on a fixed monthly salary and on a purely temporary arrangement in accordance with NACO guidelines.

content_sections.heading: GSACS Deputy Director Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the post of Deputy Director, Lab Services Division under the National AIDS Control Programme (HIV/AIDS Programme).

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: 5 years of experience for candidates with M.Sc. / B.Tech (in the above-mentioned subjects) OR 3 years of experience working in a medical diagnostic laboratory for candidates with a PhD. Candidates with experience working in accredited labs or labs that have applied for accreditation will be preferred.

rows.qualification_required: M.Sc. (Microbiology / Biotechnology / Biochemistry / Life Sciences) OR B.Tech (Biotechnology). Desirable Qualification: PhD (Microbiology / Biotechnology / Biochemistry / Life Sciences)

content_sections.heading: GSACS Deputy Director Age Limit
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit for the Deputy Director, Lab Services Division position is 50 years .

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Filled application form downloaded from the official website (www.gsacsonline.org) Original educational qualification certificates and mark sheets Original experience certificates Proof of age (Attested copy of birth date proof) Self-attested photocopies of all required certificates and documents Two recent passport-size photographs

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates must arrive at the walk-in venue between 09:30 AM and 12:00 PM on 05 November 2026 to complete the registration process. Selection will be conducted based on merit determined through educational qualifications and experience as verified during the walk-in interview.

content_sections.heading: GSACS Deputy Director Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Recruitment is made on an 11-month contract basis under NACO guidelines, carrying a fixed monthly salary on a purely temporary and ad-hoc basis. All applicants must bear their own travel and incidental expenses to attend the interview (self-financed). Candidates must bring both original documents and self-attested copies at the time of registration. The selection process and merit evaluation are strictly governed by GSACS norms, and the final decision rests with the Additional Project Director, Gujarat State AIDS Control Society. Any false information or submission of forged documents will lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage or termination without notice, along with liability for punitive action.

faq.question: Q1. When is the GSACS Deputy Director walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Deputy Director position will be held on 05 November 2026 between 09:30 AM and 12:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. What is the venue for the GSACS Deputy Director walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview takes place at the Gujarat State AIDS Control Society, Manjushree Mill Compound, Block – A, B, C & E, 5th Floor, Asarwa Bahumali Bhavan, Near Girdharnagar Bridge, Asarwa, Ahmedabad - 380004.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are announced in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Deputy Director, Lab Services Division post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Deputy Director post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. in Microbiology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, or Life Sciences, or a B.Tech in Biotechnology. A PhD in the same subjects is listed as a desirable qualification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 50 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a fixed monthly salary of Rs. 50,680/-.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should candidates bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring the filled application form, age proof, original educational and experience certificates, self-attested photocopies of all documents, and two recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent position?
faq.answer: No, this position is purely temporary on an 11-month contract basis under the HIV/AIDS Programme with fixed monthly remuneration.
